<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/rest/api/conversation/autoresponder"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Reports whether a queue is inside Business Hours (BH) or After-Business Hours (ABH) at
a given time.

When the queue is in ABH **and** an autoresponder message is configured, the message
template is returned so you can send it yourself.

Note this operation returns its result at the top level rather than inside `data`, and
does not use the `status` / `message` envelope of the other operations.
